context: Daichi and Sho-young watch a judo match on TV.
purpose: Father and son sharing sport viewing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、柔道、すごい技!
lines.en: Dad, that judo move was incredible!
lines.style: Awestruck, breathless rush of words. Voice climbs on 'incredible.' Small boy utterly absorbed in admiration. Wide-eyed wonder with a touch of bounce.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、心、ようけ強いな、選手!
lines.en: Yeah — look at that heart, champ! Real spirit!
lines.style: Warm, booming Kansai accent. Proud papa energy. Leans forward. Enthusiastic but grounded — rooting for the fighter with genuine respect, not just noise.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: The tension is so thick... I'm so nervous!
lines.style: Hushed, tense. Sits forward slightly. Whispers with real concern underneath the excitement. The worry of someone who cares deeply about the outcome.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 相手、尊重する、ええ武道や。
lines.en: That's what martial arts is about — respecting your opponent.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. Warm but measured. Like he's sharing something important with his son. Voice settles lower, thoughtful. A quiet lesson woven into watching.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Come on, let's cheer with everything we've got!
lines.style: Building energy, bright and alive. Not quite shouting but close. Pulls his son in — this is their moment together. Genuine, unselfconscious enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Full-throated, Kansai-inflected roar. Standing moment. All-in support. The kind of yell that carries real joy and complete belief in the fighter.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Pure elation, small-boy shriek. Jumps slightly. Voice cracks with delight and vindication. All the tension released at once in victory.
